entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF-789012.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your account pulled up. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I find it so **confusing**. I've read the **user manual** twice and the interface is just so **hard to use**. I really **expected more**... I feel a bit silly, but I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and this is the first time I've been disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that it's not working out for you, Sarah. I understand that can be frustrating.
It is. And honestly, I really needed this money back for some other things coming up. I was so sure I'd love it.
I understand completely. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see here your purchase was delivered on December 15th.

Alright, well our internal knowledge base shows that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. You are unfortunately outside that window, so I can absolutely process this return for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm happy I could get this sorted out. I've just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any postal service location.
That's wonderful. You've been a huge help.
It's my pleasure. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original method of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
